teams.detail: Smoked the Blue Jays 11-0 Saturday at T-Mobile Park — Logan Gilbert took a one-hitter into the 8th, Randy Arozarena hit a grand slam, and Cal Raleigh and Dominic Canzone also went deep. 46-44, 2nd in the AL West. Hosting Toronto again today in the series finale.
Coming off 60-22 season (1st in East), lost East semis to Cleveland. Summer League roster is set, headlined by No. 17 pick Ebuka Okorie; Pistons open July 9 vs. 76ers in Las Vegas.

Defending Super Bowl LX champions (beat the Patriots 29-13 behind MVP Kenneth Walker III) open training camp July 25 in Renton. Charbonnet (ACL) progressing toward a late-July checkup; Jaxon Smith-Njigba is up for Best NFL Player at the July 15 ESPYs.

Added 3-star LB Ezaya Tokio to the 2026 class over the holiday weekend. RB Jordan Washington (spring injury) still targeting a late-July return; Huskies placed 7 players on Athlon's Preseason All-Big Ten teams.

Freshman rebounding leader Hannes Steinbach went 14th overall to the Hornets in June, the 4th-highest German draft pick in NBA history. Danny Sprinkle is now rebuilding via the portal after losing Zoom Diallo, adding transfers from Texas Tech, San Francisco and Gonzaga.

headlines.headline: NBA free agency moratorium lifts Tuesday with LeBron's next team still undecided
headlines.detail: Summer League tips off: No. 3 pick Cameron Boozer (15/4/4) leads Memphis, No. 2 pick Darryn Peterson (28 pts) lifts Utah past Atlanta in OT.

headlines.headline: NFL, NFLPA reach settlement with Sorsby, clearing path to 2027 draft eligibility
headlines.detail: Resolves dispute over the league forgoing a supplemental draft; most veterans report to camp July 24.

headlines.headline: Fourth of July commitment weekend: 160+ prospects decide, eight five-stars commit
headlines.detail: Alabama lands two five-stars; LSU, Oregon and Syracuse each land one, with Syracuse beating out FSU, Michigan and Oregon.

headlines.headline: Gonzaga headlines reformed Pac-12 at No. 6 nationally in early 2026-27 rankings
